title: Offline Support & Persistence
description: Implement offline support, cache persistence, and sync strategies for React Query applications.
longDescription: This module covers offline-first strategies with React Query including cache persistence to localStorage and IndexedDB, handling network interruptions with retry and backoff logic, online and offline detection, background sync for offline mutations, and integrating persistence with service workers for progressive web apps. You will learn how to queue mutations while offline, replay them when connectivity returns, and build applications that feel responsive regardless of network conditions.
whatYouLearn: Persist React Query cache to localStorage for simple use cases
Use IndexedDB persistence for large-scale offline applications
Handle network interruptions with retry logic and exponential backoff
Detect online and offline status to adjust query behavior dynamically
Implement background sync to replay queued mutations when connectivity returns
